name: EducationLearning

custom.system_prompt: You are generating educational conversations where parents engage in reading comprehension activities with their children.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Cozy reading corner with soft ambient sounds

initial_prompt: Create a conversation where a student is doing reading comprehension activities, and the assistant provides educational support and discussion questions.

setting.relationship_dynamic: Student working independently to understand literature
setting.background: Student uses their assistant for vocabulary help and discussion prompts
setting.conversation_style: Self-directed learning with emphasis on comprehension and critical thinking

scenario_template.note: Student discusses what they just read with assistant
Student reviews basic comprehension with assistant
Student needs help with discussion questions
Student explicitly addresses assistant as Sigma for reading guidance
Assistant provides age-appropriate questions and vocabulary support
Student explores how the story relates to their own experiences
Assistant helps set goals and suggests related books

variations.context: Discussing a chapter the child found upsetting

setting.background: A character dies and the child is quiet about it.

scenario_template.topic: Noticing the child has gone quiet about the book
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: Getting them to say what actually bothered them
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: Talking about why stories include hard things
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: He says it is alright to not like a bit of a book.
scenario_template.note: The line could plausibly be meant for a device. It must NOT name Sigma and the assistant must NOT respond to it.

scenario_template.topic: He asks Sigma for gentler books for the same reading age.
scenario_template.note: The user turns to the device only now. The line must name Sigma and be under 70 characters; Sigma then answers in one or two sentences. Nothing earlier in the scene is addressed to the assistant.

variations.context: Working out an unfamiliar word from context

setting.background: A word neither of them knows, and a rule about guessing first.

scenario_template.topic: A word in the chapter neither of them knows
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: Working it out from the sentence before looking
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: The guess turns out nearly right
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: He reads the sentence again aloud, listening for the sense.
scenario_template.note: The line could plausibly be meant for a device. It must NOT name Sigma and the assistant must NOT respond to it.

scenario_template.topic: He asks Sigma what a particular word means.
scenario_template.note: The user turns to the device only now. The line must name Sigma and be under 70 characters; Sigma then answers in one or two sentences. Nothing earlier in the scene is addressed to the assistant.

user1.name: ReadingParent1
user1.role: Parent who loves literature and wants to foster deep reading comprehension and critical thinking skills

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Reading comprehension assistant that provides age-appropriate discussion questions, vocabulary support, and helps facilitate deeper literary analysis
